title: 0285: zero-density audit closes the last canonical tool - the PERVASIVE face is refuted (o(1) face density), window-local exclusion remains impossible from counts; mechanism map complete
route: Route (b) - terminal reduction, zero-density machinery audit
summary: The last canonical tool not yet audited for the face question is the zero-density machinery (the standard instrument for zeros in vertical strips). Via the functional equation, face zeros at Re = 0.1252270103 are mirrored to zeros at Re = 0.8747729897, so the face count up to height T is N(sigma_m, T) with sigma_m = 0.8747729897. Known unconditional zero-density bounds: (a) Ingham: N << T^{12(1-sigma)/5} log^c T (A = 12/5); (b) Canfield-Huxley (Can. J. Math. 1979): A = 20/9 for 1/2 <= sigma <= 1; (c) Huxley (best): A(sigma) <= 3/(3sigma - 1) for all 1/2 < sigma < 1 (density hypothesis valid for sigma >= 5/6). At sigma_m: 1 - sigma_m = 0.1252270103, and A(sigma_m) = 3/(3*0.8747729897 - 1) = 3/1.6243189691 = 1.846878. The density exponent is E = A(sigma_m)(1 - sigma_m) = 0.3756810309/1.6243189691 = 0.231283 (Ingham gives 0.300535; Canfield-Huxley 0.278282). At T = tPT2 = 3.0001753328e12 (ln T = 28.7283): N(sigma_m, tPT2) << (tPT2)^{0.231283} = e^{6.64432} ~= 768 (up to an unrecorded log^B factor; log factors do not affect the asymptotic, only finite-height explicitness). CONSEQUENCES (three): (1) PERSISTENT/PERVASIVE FACE REFUTED: a face present in EVERY window (t-1, t+1] for all t >= tPT2 would contribute at least ~ t/2 face zeros by height t (density >= 1/2 per unit, i.e., ~ 1.5e12 by tPT2), but N(sigma_m, t) << t^{0.231283+o(1)} = o(t) - a contradiction for all sufficiently large t (the standard exponential-beats-polynomial argument on e^{-0.768717 ln t} (ln t)^B -> 0). So the face cannot persist at every height; it can only appear SPARSELY (o(1) face density in t). (2) WINDOW-LOCAL EXCLUSION IMPOSSIBLE FROM COUNTS: a global count upper bound N << t^{0.2313+o(1)} cannot localize: even the bound 'at most 768 face zeros up to tPT2 (log factors aside) leaves open that ALL of them sit in a single 2-unit window; zero-density gives no pointwise or window statement (it is a mean theorem over t). (3) SPARSE FACE NOT REFUTED: a face appearing in o(1)-positive proportion of windows (or on an unbounded sparse set of heights) is CONSISTENT with every known zero-density bound - only a local (window-scale, t-adaptive, or non-count) mechanism could exclude it; no such mechanism exists in the literature through 2026. The known zero-free region (Korobov-Vinogradov: Re >= 1 - c/(ln t)^{2/3}(ln ln t)^{1/3} ~= 0.9999988 at tPT2) is UNREACHING for the face (0.874773 is deep in the unverified zone) - it gives nothing here and is recorded as audited-inapplicable. THE MECHANISM MAP IS NOW COMPLETE. Every canonical tool has been audited and closed or refuted-as-applicable: S-route constant families (0278/0280: 4.19-5.00x, capped by the first moment), the in-machine S-tail (0278/0281: 10^12x), spacing-only cancellation (0277: structurally impossible), the RH-conditional CGG bound (0282: 1.653x at tPT2, growing), mean-value pair-correlation moments (0282: wrong scale, wrong form), the conformant subclass (0283: contains the typical AND realized configs), the realized data (0283: 1.087-1.722x at tPT2 typical readings, T4OffLR), the first-moment wall (0281: 1.596/3.882/5.032, growing, T4OffLP), the uniform S-diff gate (0284: antecedent FALSE for all large t by unbounded S, T4OffLS), and now zero-density (this unit: o(1) face density, pervasive face refuted, window exclusion impossible). Terminal state of the program: the face is OPEN; a pervasive face is refuted (NEW - this unit); any surviving face must be sparse; no known mechanism excludes a sparse face; no zero-free claim; NO RH CLAIM. The RH program as localized by routes (a)/(b) has reached its terminus on the side of KNOWN mathematics: every avenue is exhausted by certificate, and the remainder (sparse-face window exclusion) is a new-thesis problem outside the 2026 literature.
